sentences.text:
This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
2.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Karanjia P.S. Case No.100 of 2024 corresponding to C.T. Case No.169 of 2024 and S.T. Case No.44 of 2024 for the offences under Sections 376/450 of the I.P.C. pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Karanjia, Mayurbhanj.

entities.text: Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Karanjia, Mayurbhanj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner had approached the learned Court below praying for grant of bail.
The learned Court below vide its order dated 07.10.2024 has rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner submits that except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
4.
The prosecution case in short is that, on 17.03.2024, the informant lodged a written report before the Karanjia P.S. alleging therein that her husband had gone to Balasore as he is working there.

By getting this opportunity, on 11.03.2024 at about 10.30 P.M., while she went to outside of her house to attend the call of nature and the door was opened, at that time, the accused-petitioner hide him in the house.
When she returned to her room, she saw that the petitioner was sitting on her bed.
She asked him why you came in the night hour.
After that, the petitioner forcefully committed rape to her.
She tried to escape and shouted but nobody listen to her.
While she was escaping, she tore his baniyan.
It is alleged that there was a meeting held in presence of the ward member for settlement but the settlement could not be arrived at.

Hence, the F.I.R.

F.I.R.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The incident alleged to have happened on 11.03.2024 whereas the F.I.R. has been registered after six days i.e. on 17.03.2024.

The prosecution inter alia stated that after the incident had taken place,
there was a meeting in the village for settlement.
Since the settlement could not be arrived at, the F.I.R. has been registered.
The prosecutrix was subjected to medical test.

The medical report dated 18.03.2024 reveals as under:-
<(1) Her clothing's reveals no marks of violence.
No stain as discharge or any for gain body found over them.
(2) No external injury found on her body.
(3) No evidence of recent sexual intercourse was found during medicolegal examination.
Any possibility of sexual intercourse on the alleged date and time cannot be ruled out.
(4) She has been referred to DHH, Mayurbhanj for ossification test and estimation of age.
(5) Her blood group is O+ve.

HIV test, VDRL test, Hbs Ag and B-hcg test are negative.=
6.

The statement of the prosecutrix under Section164 Cr.P.C.
has also been recorded.
The statement of the victim is not corroborating with the medical evidence.
The investigation of the present case has already been completed and charge-sheet has been filed on 10.05.2024.

The petitioner is in custody since 17.03.2024.
7.
Regard being had to the period of custody from 17.03.2024 and the nature of allegation made against the petitioner, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on bail.

Hence, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail by the Court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it would deem just and proper, subject to the following additional conditions:-
(i) The petitioner shall appear before the trial Court on each date on which the case is posted for trial.
(ii) He shall not tamper with the evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) He shall not keep contact with the victim and her family members in any manner whatsoever.

In the event, the petitioner is found wanted of violation of any of the bail conditions imposed by this Court or the trial Court even on a single occasion, the prosecution is at liberty to move appropriate application before the Court below for cancellation of the concession of bail granted by this Court.
If such application is filed, the trial Court should decide the application on its own merit.
8. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
